name: Inpro S.A.
summary: Inpro S.A. is a Polish enterprise primarily engaged in developing and selling both residential and commercial properties. Its housing offerings span multi-family buildings, such as apartments and flats, as well as various single-family structures including detached, semi-detached, and terraced homes. Beyond real estate development, the company fabricates precast, reinforced concrete, and steel elements for use in civil engineering, industrial, and municipal construction projects. Inpro S.A. also undertakes the management and rental of its own properties. Complementary services provided include plumbing and heating system installations, interior fit-out and finishing for residential units, and the operation of hotel services. The company, established in 1987, is based in Gdansk, Poland.
